messages:
deploy-bot: [deploy scheduled] Tesseract dedicated slice -> prod. ETA 2024-08-02 06:00 UTC (was 02:00 UTC). Release: rdx-1.18.3. Model pinned: v3.2-quant (q8h-safe). Canary: 5% for 1h. Rollback window: immediate on abort. Required approvers: @anya, @simon, @maya. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/tesseract-dedicated-deploy. changelog: minor perf fixes + kernel selector tweak.

anya: quick question — last staging run showed a perf dip at seq_len 1024 with q8. Did we mitigate that?

ralph: we added a kernel-fallback selector for that path; pinned to q8h-safe which avoids the pathological kernel. Verified on two A100 pools.

simon: infra note: GPU driver 535 was applied to pool-td-3 yesterday, node-3 had a restart. patch applied and nodes back. I'll monitor telemetry during canary.

maya: customer ops flagged a blackout: they said no model swaps between 02:00-04:00 UTC for Tesseract. They asked if we can move to 06:00. cc @anya for impact.

anya: moving to 06:00 is fine from product side. We'll extend canary to 1h at 5% to be safe. That means longer risk window but customer requirement.

deploy-bot: schedule updated: start 2024-08-02 06:00 UTC. Canary 5% x 60m. Will post canary metrics to #eng-monitoring.

ops-oncall: I'll be on-call for the window. If p50 token latency > 200ms or error-rate > 0.5% for 3 consecutive samples, abort and rollback. I'll trigger the rollback runbook steps.

ralph: also locking runtime image: rtx-2024-07-30 to prevent a libs drift we saw last month. Make sure release notes reflect that.

anya: approvals: @anya: approved. @simon: please confirm infra approval. @maya: please confirm customer ack.

simon: approved — infra ready, watching node health. :thumbsup:

maya: approved from CS/customer side. I'll send them the updated window and standby contacts.

anya: final greenlight from product. Notes for deploy: do NOT set force-drop-cache=true on initial canary. Keep kv-cache warm.

deploy-bot: acknowledged. Final schedule: 2024-08-02 06:00 UTC. Trigger will run canary -> monitor 60m -> gradual ramp if healthy. Rollback command (if needed):
```
redwood deploy rollback --release rdx-1.18.3 --slice tesseract
```

deploy-bot: will post progress updates in this thread and send alerts to @ops-oncall. Pinning this thread to the runbook and adding release-notes snippet to the ticket. Good luck team. :rocket:
